name: hswm-evidence-preserving-world-compiler
purpose: Deterministically compile frozen sources and recorded extraction, linking, and embedding observations into an immutable evidence-preserving HSWM world artifact or a typed rejection.
rationale: The current semantics are still changing and the repository has several disconnected execution paths.
No authoritative mutable-state owner, durable ingestion service, scheduler, queue, or recovery obligation exists yet.
A pure compiler creates the required evidence and identity seam without prematurely manufacturing runtime machinery.
The planned ecosystem consumers are named in research canon but are not yet independent production consumers of one stable IR.

boundary.owns: Evidence validation, stable identity, lossless source-to-assertion topology, deterministic projections, quarantine, technical statistics, and a content-addressed build manifest
boundary.mechanism: Compile canonical source snapshots, frozen observations, and an explicit policy into WorldArtifactV1 with paragraph, binary, and role-aware n-ary projections
policy_outside: Extractor, linker, embedder, and ontology-provider selection
Entity merge thresholds and contradiction policy
Field parameters, readout policy, and certification thresholds
Persistence backend, scheduling, retry, authentication, and deployment
non_goals: Live model or network calls inside the compiler
Automatic truth judgment or automatic supersession
Mutable runtime ownership, queues, retries, or durable execution
boundary.state_authority: The compiler owns no mutable state; callers own frozen inputs and published artifacts, while accepted supersession decisions are supplied as a separate ledger snapshot

invariants: Identical canonical inputs produce an identical build ID and identical projections.
Every accepted mention, assertion, entity mapping, and field target traces to at least one source digest and exact evidence selector.
Question, answer, supporting flags, and gold labels are excluded from compiler inputs.
Stable IDs are independent of dense-array order; every dense projection records a bijective stable-ID map.
Entity resolution never deletes source mentions or source-specific assertions.
Argument roles, order, polarity, modality, qualifiers, and time are not collapsed into unordered incidence.
Missing observations, dangling references, invalid spans, incompatible schemas, non-finite vectors, and duplicate IDs with different payloads are rejected without mutation.
failure_model: Malformed or incompatible input returns a typed CompileRejectionV1 without an artifact.
A source hash, span, observation, model revision, or policy mismatch fails closed rather than triggering an implicit external call.
Unsupported or low-confidence semantic material is quarantined with evidence instead of silently merged or discarded.
verification: Golden parity tests compare the current BuiltWorld, field values, retrieve order, selection distribution, and mu-zero traversal against the legacy projection.
Property tests cover input-order invariance, stable IDs, canonical hashes, evidence round trips, and tamper rejection.
Leakage tests prove that evaluation labels cannot affect the world artifact.
Projection tests compare paragraph, binary, and role-aware n-ary views from the same immutable IR.
promotion_gates: At least two independent current consumers use the same stable WorldArtifact contract.
Incremental ingestion is required because full deterministic rebuilds are no longer practical.
Concurrent writers require one authoritative mutable-state owner and explicit ordering.
Crash recovery, durable deduplication, atomic publication, cancellation, or outbox delivery becomes a real obligation.
Bounded queues, backpressure, scheduling, and schema migration are required by measured operations.
The IR remains stable across at least two datasets and two artifact releases.
falsifiers: If the compatibility adapter is more complex than the current consumers or leaks consumer policy into the IR, keep separate modules instead.
If two real consumers require incompatible core semantics, do not promote a false common engine boundary.
If deterministic full rebuild remains cheap and sufficient, retain the pure module indefinitely.
